bootlegger: Registrar is a character from Homebrews By Luis. Thanks Luis!

name: Registrar
ability: When you learn that you died, declare that, going clockwise, half of alive good players must claim who they are, or your team loses.
flavor: What’s your name? Your occupation? Where do you live? How would you rank your coworkers from 1-10? Where were you on the night of the 7th? Have you met the magic man and gained his mystical powers? Have you discovered the secret 13th dimension? Finally, how are you feeling today?

jinxes.reason: If the Registrar is nominated and the Matsuraid is in play, they use their ability.

name: Decamatio
otherNightReminder: If it is night X+2, wake the Decamatio and show them the grimoire. Show fingers equalling half of all living players (rounded up or down to get closest to final 3). They choose that many players to be killed.
ability: On Night X+2, see the grimoire & choose half of all living players: they die. Each day, if no alive player was executed, evil wins. [X Outsiders]
flavor: Ludus finitus est, turma mala vicit.
